ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution covering approximately 85% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized at distal tips and as scattered focal points.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations; distinct deep U-shaped and V-shaped notches at irregular intervals along the trailing edge of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel, high-intensity diagonal linear disruptions on the upper quadrant of the right lobe; several shorter, unaligned linear scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue voids/notches along the trailing edge, particularly a prominent semi-circular gouge on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; distal tips show dense, complex high-contrast clustering.
